scope: New joint hardware only, all6 corners+4 actuator retainers. No frame, arm bodies, uprights, existing pins, drives, wheels, dampers or actuators. New source-dimensioned purchased-shape proxies, not OEMCAD.
replacements: Remove C02 bearing FIT ENVELOPE display geometry before adding GE20ES ball/race parts.
Remove C03 tie_tube/tie_insert_RH/tie_insert_LH; replace once with these nodes.
C04 arm copies in this directory are superseded pending parent miter-corrected geometry.
Replace old C03 outer_pins_left group; this manifest contains8 new single outer pins for72mm forks.
Use four fork72 carrier copies from fork_and_pin_revision_C04_R02.json; preserves parent breakout holes.

dynamic_rules.arm: Follow C03_R03 fixed upper/lower pivots, side orientation properRz(pi); Rx(side*q).
dynamic_rules.upright: C03 solver yaw about actual nominal kingpin, then suspension translation.
dynamic_rules.tie_body: Transport nominal inner-to-outer frame by minimal rotation to solved vector. Keep length310.367524074mm.
dynamic_rules.tie_ball_and_HB: Ball and HB spacers follow pin orientation, NOT tie body rotation. Both joint centers coincide while tilt changes.
dynamic_rules.root_ball_vs_race: Root ball/inner spacer/cheek spacer remain fixed with pin; race/outer spacer/end retainers rotate with arm about the same axis.
dynamic_rules.middle_outer: Paired GE20ES retainers/races follow arms; balls/inner spacers/pin retainers follow fixed-yaw upright translation.
dynamic_rules.actuator: Rear eye pins fixed; front pins/retainers translate rack. Preserve free eye gaps.

outer_joint_shim_allocation.acceptance_before_fabrication: Measure actual fork gap G and assembled bearing+HB span S. Select equal or near-equal shims Pleft/Pright within available1.023mm nominal per-side allocation, keeping G-S-Pleft-Pright positive. Proposed target total free clearance0.10..0.25mm is original, requires application engineering approval. Do not force clamps or machine to a nominal number without tolerance stack.
